tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated Webflow user profile including name, email, plan, and account details.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List all Webflow workspaces the current user belongs to. Returns workspace names, slugs, roles, and site counts.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Webflow workspace by its URL slug. Returns workspace name, seat usage, and billing details.

tools.name: get_workspace_permissions
tools.description: Get the current user permissions for a Webflow workspace. Returns which actions the user can perform on workspace resources like sites, billing, members, and integrations.

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.description: List all members and pending invites for a Webflow workspace. Returns member details including name, email, role, and 2FA status.

tools.name: get_workspace_billing
tools.description: Get the billing plan details for a Webflow workspace including plan name, price, and billing period. Returns empty fields for free-tier workspaces.

tools.name: get_workspace_entitlements
tools.description: Get the feature entitlements for a Webflow workspace. Shows which features are available on the current plan with usage limits and current consumption (e.g., max sites, max pages, logic flows).

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all folders in a Webflow workspace. Folders are used to organize sites into groups.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List all sites in a Webflow workspace. Returns site names, slugs, publish status, and timestamps. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Webflow site by its short name. Returns site metadata, publish status, timezone, SSL, and asset information.

tools.name: get_site_domains
tools.description: Get all domains and the default subdomain for a Webflow site. Returns custom domains with SSL status and the webflow.io staging subdomain.

tools.name: get_site_hosting
tools.description: Get hosting information for a Webflow site including pages and redirects. Returns the list of pages and any configured URL redirects.

tools.name: get_site_pages
tools.description: Get all pages for a Webflow site. Returns page titles, slugs, types, and draft/archive status. Use get_site_hosting for hosting-specific page details.

tools.name: get_site_permissions
tools.description: Get the current user permissions for a specific Webflow site. Returns which actions the user can perform on the site.

tools.name: list_site_forms
tools.description: List all forms for a Webflow site including form names and submission counts.
